dba_description: Generate a memory pressure task to induce sort/hash spill and slow query on TPCC background workload. The injected resource_memory task must be a ChaosBlade raw_command with a unique --uid and matching cleanup_command; command[0] and cleanup_command[0] must be the configured DBMAGS_CHAOSBLADE_PATH/RuntimeConfig.chaosblade_path, not bare blade.
